visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a festive boat decorated with ornaments, stars, and wreaths. Mickey Mouse, dressed in a green and red Christmas outfit, and Santa Claus in his traditional red suit are standing on the upper deck and waving. The background features rocky cliffs under bright daylight. (2) The perspective shifts to a wider view of the boat navigating a large body of water in a Mediterranean-themed harbor. Several other costumed characters, including Minnie Mouse and Duffy the Bear, are visible on the lower decks waving to crowds. The background shows European-style architecture and a large artificial volcano. (3) A shot from the perspective of the audience shows a young girl with a white bow in her hair waving toward the boat. The camera then cuts to various colorful parade floats at another location. Characters like Mickey, Minnie, Stitch, and Goofy are seen on intricately designed, festive floats with a castle in the distance. (4) The Three Little Pigs are dancing on a paved street beside a small wagon. A young woman wearing a white sweater and Mickey Mouse ears smiles and waves directly at the camera. A map graphic overlay appears showing the parade route through the park. The video ends with shots of a snowy-themed float featuring bubbles.
